title: [choke-point-split 31/36] Import choke-point symbols from their owning modules in the remaining production callers

labels.name: spec:approved
labels.description: Spec passed /define-behavior audit — ready for the dispatcher to pick up

body:
**Blocked by:** #506, #513, #514

## Context

During the split, `backend/packages/data/src/chokePoint/chokePoint.ts` re-exports every symbol that moved out, so callers kept working. The target design has no barrel: a caller imports a symbol from the module that owns it (`docs/adr/2026-09-24-choke-point-composed-from-domain-modules.md`). This issue redirects the remaining production callers outside `mail/`, `inbox/` and `seed/`. Sibling issues redirect the other caller groups in parallel, and #528 removes the re-exports once every group is done.

Owning modules, all under `backend/packages/data/src/`:
- `createItemWithClient`, `updateItemWithClient`, `writeComputedAndAnnounce` and the item input types: `chokePoint/itemWrites.ts`
- `createRelationWithClient`, `updateRelationWithClient`, `deleteRelationWithClient`, `assertRelationCreatableWithClient` and the relation input types: `chokePoint/relationOps.ts`
- `createRelationPropertyWithClient`, `CreateRelationPropertyInput`: `chokePoint/relationPropertyOps.ts`
- `SystemRelationWriteContext`: `chokePoint/relationEdgeContext.ts`
- `enqueueRollupRecomputeForEdge`: `rollup/recompute.ts`
- `computeDestructiveResourceProjection` and the resource-snapshot types: `chokePoint/destructiveProjection.ts`
- `Actor`: `chokePoint/authorization.ts`
- `createChokePoint`, `ChokePoint`: stay in `chokePoint/chokePoint.ts`

## Task

In each file listed under Touches, replace every import from `chokePoint/chokePoint(.js)` with imports from the owning modules above. Imports of `createChokePoint` and `ChokePoint` stay pointed at `chokePoint.ts`. Keep `type` modifiers as they are. Change nothing else in these files.

## Touches

- backend/packages/data/src/blobs/fileUploadStore.ts
- backend/packages/data/src/journal/journalStore.ts
- backend/packages/data/src/library/libraryMetadataJob.ts
- backend/packages/data/src/mcp/mcpSync.ts
- backend/packages/data/src/tasks/advanceTaskRecurrence.ts
- backend/packages/data/src/transcription/transcriptEventMatch.ts
- backend/packages/data/src/transcription/transcriptSpeakerSuggestion.ts

## Scope

### In scope
- Import statements in the files listed above.

### Out of scope
- Any other caller group (sibling redirect issues).
- Removing the re-exports from `chokePoint.ts` (#528).
- `packages/data/src/index.ts` (#528).

## Acceptance criteria

- `pnpm run verify` in `backend/` passes. `src/__tests__/publicSurface.test.ts` passes unmodified.
- In the listed files, the only remaining imports from `chokePoint/chokePoint` are `createChokePoint` and/or `ChokePoint` (`grep -n "chokePoint/chokePoint\|\./chokePoint\.js" <files>` shows nothing else).
- The diff of each listed file touches only import lines.
